intro: Einar Stonegrip is a dwarven trapper stationed along the main crossroads of the Wetlands. Rather than risk an uncomfortable reunion with his estranged wife in Menethil Harbor, he relies on passing adventurers to haul his crocolisk skins to town.

p: Perched at the central intersection connecting Dun Algaz, Dun Modr, and Menethil Harbor, Einar Stonegrip earns his living braving the sodden marshes of the Wetlands. He hunts the local crocolisks for their sturdy hides, supplying leatherworkers and merchants along the coast. Though rugged enough to wrestle reptiles out of the mire, he is thoroughly cowed by domestic strife. Embroiled in a bitter falling-out with his wife, Sida, Einar stays out on the road, hiring travelers to deliver his bundles of skins to his trading partner James Halloran rather than set foot in Menethil Harbor himself.
